title: Space efficient implementation of hypergraph dualization in the D-basis algorithm
abstract: arXiv:2512.06988v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: We present a new implementation of the $D$-basis algorithm called the Small Space which considerably reduces the algorithm's memory usage for data analysis applications. The previous implementation delivers the complete set of implications that hold on the set of attributes of an input binary table. In the new version, the only output is the frequencies of attributes that appear in the antecedents of implications from the $D$-basis, with a fixed consequent attribute. Such frequencies, rather than the implications themselves, became the primary focus in analysis of datasets where the $D$-basis has been applied over the last decade. The $D$-basis employs a hypergraph dualization algorithm, and a dualization implementation known as Reverse Search allows for the gradual computation of frequencies without the need for storing all discovered implications. translated_title: D-基算法中超图对偶化的空间高效实现
translated_abstract: 我们提出了一种名为 Small Space 的 D-基（D-basis）算法新实现，可显著降低该算法在数据分析应用中的内存使用量。先前的实现会输出在输入二值表属性集上成立的全部蕴涵关系；而在新版本中，唯一的输出是与固定后件属性相对应的、出现在 D-基蕴涵前件中的属性频率。在过去十年中，在应用 D-基的数据集分析中，这类频率（而非蕴涵关系本身）已成为主要关注点。D-基采用超图对偶化算法，而一种称为反向搜索的对偶化实现允许逐步计算这些频率，而无需存储所有已发现的蕴涵关系。我们通过对比实验证明了 Small Space 实现的有效性。
tldr: 提出了一种名为 Small Space 的 D-基算法新实现，借助反向搜索的超图对偶化方法在不存储全部蕴涵关系的情况下逐步计算属性频率，大幅降低了数据分析中的内存占用。
en_tdlr: A new "Small Space" implementation of the D-basis algorithm leverages reverse search hypergraph dualization to gradually compute attribute frequencies without storing all discovered implications, substantially reducing memory usage in data analysis applications.
